quotes.speaker: Giannis Antetokounmpo
quotes.summary_phrase: Giannis Antetokounmpo on his parents' struggle and inspiration
quotes.excerpt: Seeing my mom and dad struggling every single day to provide for us.
quotes.quote: Mom, dad, seeing my mom and dad struggling every single day to provide for us. Being the king from Nigeria in 1991, and they had my brother Thanasis and they had us and they left their own family, their own brothers and own sisters, their mom and dad in an unknown territory, unknown country, had us. Obviously, we faced a lot of difficulties, a lot of racism, but at the end of the day, my dad thought that this was the right place for us to have a good education, to be raised.

quotes.summary_phrase: Giannis Antetokounmpo on his favorite players, LeBron James and Michael Jordan
quotes.excerpt: The person that I like to watch a lot is LeBron James.
quotes.quote: You can't compare eras, but the person that I like to watch a lot is LeBron James. I like to watch him. But obviously Michael Jordan, it's one and two. Once you get to that level, who cares? Some people say LeBron, some people say MJ.

quotes.speaker: Giannis Antetokounmpo
quotes.summary_phrase: Giannis Antetokounmpo on the problem of foul-baiting in the NBA
quotes.excerpt: I feel like sometimes when you work all summer to manipulate the game, you get rewarded.
quotes.quote: I feel like sometimes when you work all summer to manipulate the game, and then you get rewarded for that. People that actually play straightforward like me, when they go down the paint and I get hacked and I say that's a foul, they always tell me like, oh yeah, you're too strong. You didn't show me that it was a foul. My job is not to show you it was a foul. My job is to play through contact. And I feel like people that actually do like that, they get calls all the time. It should be the other way around.

quotes.speaker: Giannis Antetokounmpo
quotes.summary_phrase: Giannis Antetokounmpo on his goals for the future
quotes.excerpt: My goal is to win another championship. My goal is for my kids to be healthy.
quotes.quote: My goal is to win another championship. My goal is for my kids to be healthy and happy.

quotes.speaker: Giannis Antetokounmpo
quotes.summary_phrase: Giannis Antetokounmpo on his World Cup favorites
quotes.excerpt: I'm with Portugal. I want to see Cristiano Ronaldo win his World Cup.
quotes.quote: I'm with Portugal. I want to see Cristiano Ronaldo win his World Cup. But I also support think France is a really good team with Mbappe. I think Argentina is a beautiful country, great team, one of the best players to ever play the game. But I want the happiness to be spread. I want everybody to be happy. So I want Ronaldo to be happy too. Messi is happy, he won last year. So maybe Portugal or France.

quotes.speaker: Giannis Antetokounmpo
quotes.summary_phrase: Giannis Antetokounmpo on his post-retirement plans
quotes.excerpt: Either I'm going to be a stay-at-home dad or I'm going to be a coach.
quotes.quote: Either I'm going to be a stay-at-home dad or I'm going to be a coach. I want to be a coach in the NBA.
